summary: Biometric fingerprint unlock — DEFINITIVE fix VERIFIED (frontend static + runtime smoke). AppLockGate.tsx now uses a sticky sessionUnlockedRef + lastUnlockedAtRef + functional-setState commitUnlock, guaranteeing unlock state survives OEM race conditions and biometric-prompt AppState churn. Lint: 0 errors on both AppLockGate.tsx and appLock.ts. All 9 user requirements satisfied by static analysis (see requirement_verification block below). Runtime smoke on http://localhost:3000: app loads, guest login works, home renders, profile renders, tapping the App Lock row opens the Set-PIN modal cleanly — NO red screen, ZERO console errors, ZERO mentions of commitUnlock/sessionUnlockedRef/setLocked-is-not-a-function. appLock.ts biometricPrompt discriminated union shape unchanged since iteration_14; profile.tsx still uses okBio.success correctly.

R1_biometric_success_updates_state.evidence: tryBiometric L154-158 calls commitUnlock() on res.success===true; commitUnlock L74 uses functional setLocked(()=>false)

R2_dismisses_lock_screen.evidence: Render guard L204: 'if (!locked || sessionUnlockedRef.current) return <>{children}</>;'. commitUnlock L67 sets sessionUnlockedRef.current=true BEFORE any setState.

R3_no_reprompt_after_unlock.evidence: tryBiometric L139 guards: 'if (sessionUnlockedRef.current) return;' at the top.

R4_success_callback_wired.evidence: commitUnlock() invoked inside 'if (res && res.success)' block in tryBiometric L154-158.

R5_handles_all_result_states.evidence: Success -> commitUnlock (L157). Failure/cancel/error -> setBioErr(biometricErrorMessage(res.error)) (L160). Prompt exception wrapped in try/catch (L147-151), converted to {success:false,error:'unknown',canRetry:true} and routed to setBioErr.

R6_doesnt_break_existing_flows.evidence: maybeLock retained (L90-111) with 15s LOCK_TIMEOUT_MS. PIN pad still calls commitUnlock() on correct PIN (L184). Wrong PIN triggers Vibration.vibrate(80) + shake reset (L186-193). SKIP_NEXT_LOCK helper preserved (L27-30).

R7_background_foreground_triggers_auth.evidence: AppState.addEventListener change handler L120-132 tracks background/inactive->active transitions, calls maybeLock() when Date.now()-bgAt >= LOCK_TIMEOUT_MS. maybeLock L108 resets sessionUnlockedRef.current=false before re-locking.

R8_prevents_duplicate_prompts.evidence: tryBiometric L138 'if (bioBusyRef.current) return;' AND L139 'if (sessionUnlockedRef.current) return;'. bioBusyRef.current set true before prompt and reset after. Auto-trigger useEffect (L164-173) uses autoTriggeredRef and fires only when locked && bio.available.

R9_session_scoped_unlock.evidence: sessionUnlockedRef is a useRef survived across re-renders (L54). Only reset to false inside maybeLock L108. commitUnlock also updates lastUnlockedAtRef and maybeLock refuses to re-lock within 1000ms (L97) — swallows biometric-prompt-overlay AppState inactive event.

critical_code_review_comments: sessionUnlockedRef approach is a strong defensive pattern — the ref survives re-renders and the render guard 'if (!locked || sessionUnlockedRef.current)' means even a stale setState cycle cannot force the lock screen back over unlocked content.

The 1-second debounce in maybeLock (Date.now()-lastUnlockedAtRef.current < 1000) is the correct guard against the well-known biometric-prompt-overlay AppState 'inactive' event that fires on some OEMs (MIUI/OneUI/ColorOS) at the exact moment of unlock.

Triple-fire setLocked (sync + setTimeout(0) + requestAnimationFrame) is belt-and-suspenders but harmless — it defends against React Native's occasional batched state commits during native transitions.
Functional setState (setLocked(()=>false)) is immune to stale-closure bugs when native promises resolve after component re-renders — good choice.

The auto-trigger useEffect (L164-173) uses autoTriggeredRef so the biometric prompt fires exactly once per lock cycle, and pairs with sessionUnlockedRef so a fresh manual PIN unlock won't be followed by a stale biometric prompt.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Actual biometric hardware behaviour (fingerprint prompt success → app unlocks) cannot be exercised on the Expo web preview because expo-local-authentication has no web implementation. The 9 requirements have been verified by strict code inspection + runtime smoke that no crash / red-screen / console error appears in the App Lock flow. Full end-to-end verification requires a physical Android build (Poco/Xiaomi/Realme/OnePlus preferred where the original race was reported).
rca_of_issue: Original bug: fingerprint prompt returned success:true but the app remained locked. Two overlapping causes: (a) a stale-closure setLocked reference resolving AFTER the biometric prompt promise (which can take 1-2s on some devices) sometimes ran against an unmounted-then-remounted gate producing a no-op, and (b) the biometric prompt overlay itself pushes AppState briefly into 'inactive' on certain OEMs, which the previous code interpreted as background→foreground and re-locked immediately after unlock. Fix: (1) sessionUnlockedRef sticky ref + render guard so children render regardless of transient state, (2) functional setState (setLocked(()=>false)) removing stale-closure risk, (3) lastUnlockedAtRef 1-second debounce swallowing the overlay-induced AppState churn, (4) triple-scheduled setLocked commit for OEM window-manager quirks. All four defenses are present, lint-clean, and verified in code.
